title: chat.conversation.created payload (v1)
description: Emitted when a deterministic direct conversation is created. This is a one-shot creation event: the envelope carries no aggregate fields (aggregate_type/aggregate_id/aggregate_version are absent), because creation is not a versioned mutation of an existing aggregate. member_user_ids contains exactly the two projected member accounts, derived from the sorted deterministic pair.

kind.description: This slice emits only direct conversations; community channels are created by the isomorphic community flow.

member_user_ids.description: Exactly the two member accounts; soft references to chat_db.chat_users.id. Read cursors are per user and never appear here.

crypto_protocol.description: Envelope/protocol identifier for the conversation, e.g. dev-opaque-v1.
